pages.text:
Bakes coal into coal coke, collecting creosote as it goes. It needs no fuel.
Build it from Carbonizer blocks all facing the same way, as slices side by side: each slice 2 or 3 tall and 2 or 3 deep, up to 8 slices. Every slice bakes in parallel, and bigger slices bake more at once.
Pipe the creosote out, or it will fill up and stop.
